issues.label: CouchDB receiver
issues.reason: A beta metrics receiver with one active code owner, so the surface you have to learn before contributing is small and review will be focused.

issues.label: Group by trace processor
issues.reason: A beta traces processor with one code owner; its buffering behaviour is easy to exercise directly with unit tests.

issues.label: InfluxDB exporter
issues.reason: A beta exporter covering logs, metrics and traces with a single active owner — a good landing spot for backend-specific fixes.

issues.label: Count connector
issues.reason: Connectors are one of the smallest classes in contrib, and this one has a single owner with a well-defined, self-contained counting behaviour.

issues.label: Basic auth extension
issues.reason: An auth extension with one active owner, where configuration parsing and round-trip tests keep the blast radius of any change small.

issues.label: Carbon receiver
issues.reason: A beta metrics receiver speaking a plain-text line protocol over UDP or TCP, which makes it straightforward to reproduce a report locally.

issues.label: [exporter/elasticsearch] Document indexed document structure
issues.reason: A documentation-only issue already labelled `good first issue`: explain how the exporter indexes documents, with no behaviour change and therefore a low-risk first pull request.
